note: Quiet window. One correction: the city of Kish itself is drawn as Sumerian city-states land while Kish is an independent state.

region.text: the city of Kish and its fields: 'located 80 km south of Baghdad and 12 km east of the ancient city of Babylon' in Babil Governorate

events.note: 2400 BCE: Kug-Bau's Kish holds its own city and fields again. Kish III is dated 'c. 2430 – c. 2360 BC'; Kug-Bau 'r. c. 2400 BC', 'said to have gained independence from En-anna-tum I of Lagash and En-shag-kush-ana of Uruk' (historicity 'uncertain'). The compiled map holds the city's own 40 km disk (15 of 19 cells) as Sumerian city-states land from -2750 on (Kish's keyframe loses the overlap to the collective, Kish's successor), while Kish's 96 cells lie in Diyala and Karbala; this returns the disk the dossier itself uses for the -2350 and -2340 events (kish/ledger/4, sumerian-city-states/ledger/9), so that Enshakushanna's seizure of Kish (-2350) and Lugal-zage-si's annexation (-2340) act on Kish land.
